set-variable.value: #[output application/json --- if(write(error.errorType,"application/java") contains "NOT_FOUND") 404 else if(write(error.errorType,"application/java") contains "BAD_REQUEST") 400 else if(write(error.errorType,"application/java") contains "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED") 405 else if(write(error.errorType,"application/java") contains "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE") 415 else if(write(error.errorType,"application/java") contains "UNAUTHORIZED") 401 else 500]
set-variable.doc:name: Set ErrorCode

logger.doc:name: Log Error
logger.message: #[output application/json import * from logging --- errorLog(vars.appName,vars.flowName,"ERROR", vars.correlationId, vars.uniqueId, vars.transactionType, vars.errorCode, write(error.errorType,'application/java'), error.description)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "appName": app.name, "logLevel": "ERROR", "correlationId": vars.correlationId default correlationId, "uniqueId": vars.uniqueId default {}, "transactionType": vars.transactionType default "", "errorCode": vars.errorCode, "errorType": write(error.errorType,"application/java"), "errorDescription": error.description }
